lines.latin: Daai Cheung Sik Ban Si Cheung (Dah Chong food market)

lines.text: SUPERMERCADO DAH CHONG • DAH CHONG SUPERMARKET

notes: Macau old town. Target is the lower green fascia over the door. The upper fascia repeats the name but is cut at the frame edge and spells 'DHA CHONG SUPERM...'. The old gilt sign between them reads 'MAN SENG SIU LAP KA' with 萬勝燒臘家 written right to left (stylised 臘), a former shop. Red side panels list goods (美國..., 潤膚, 沙甸魚 ...). TAI-LEI logo. Shoppers on the pavement, one walking close to the camera, are incidental.
